description:
Review the Public Records Request SOP document at /home/ga/Documents/records_request_sop_draft.docx. The document contains tracked changes and comments from two reviewers (Maria Santos and James Park). You must:
1. ACCEPT the following changes: 'written or electronic request', '5 business days', the inserted fee sentence, 'mail, email, or in-person pickup', and 'designated Records Officer'.
2. REJECT the following changes (keep original text): deletion of the ORS exemption sentence, change to 'may acknowledge', deletion of the Appeal Process paragraph, and change to '30 business days'.
3. DELETE all comments.
4. Save the finalized clean document to /home/ga/Documents/records_request_sop_final.docx.

required_text: Fees for electronic copies shall not exceed
Records exempt under ORS 192.345 through 192.505 shall not be disclosed
Any person denied access to a public record
